meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 探索代码时会优先使用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 代替直接读文件:先搜索符号、看文件结构,再按需展开单个函数的源码,省 token。
howto.when: 当你要理解代码结构、查找函数或高效浏览代码库时,该技能会接管默认的读文件行为,改用三个 smart_* 工具。

say.text: 帮我找 shutdown 相关的函数在哪些文件里
say.note: 会调用 smart_search 搜索并返回排名符号。

say.text: 看一下 worker-service.ts 的结构
say.note: 会调用 smart_outline 生成文件骨架。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude explores code using smart_search, smart_outline, and smart_unfold instead of reading whole files by default. It first builds a structural map, then unfolds only the symbols you need, saving tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or efficiently explore a codebase. It overrides the default exploration behavior (Read/Grep/Glob) with the smart_* tools.

say_en.text: Find which files contain shutdown-related functions
say_en.note: Triggers smart_search to return ranked symbols.

say_en.text: Show me the structure of worker-service.ts
say_en.note: Triggers smart_outline to build a file skeleton.
Triggers smart_unfold to fetch the full function source.
